The "'''Peacemaker's Day'''" speech was a famous speech issued by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bouris Ulgo]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that saw him declare himself [[King/Legends|King]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. He issued the speech before a group of his [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], but broadcast the speech across the planet. Ulgo's declaration sparked full-fledged [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]].
